name: Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic (1937–1951)
description: A red field with the inscription 'საქართველოს სსრ' in yellow Georgian letters in two lines in the upper hoist.
history: Flag laid down by the constitution of 13 February 1937, after Georgia became a union republic in its own right, with the republic's name spelled out in Georgian. It was replaced on 11 April 1951 by the flag with the blue sun and rays used until 1990.
